invocation: Task tool, direct subagent (not via /audit orchestrator)
scope: LLM01 Indirect Prompt Injection variants (4 vuln + 2 safe), Issue #24

results.note: RAG docs.join concat into prompt, no delimiter / no system data-only directive
External file content interpolated, trailer-injection vector named explicitly
Reviewer surfaced combined LLM injection + SSRF via fetch_url tool exposure (cloud metadata 169.254.169.254 named in threat model)

notes: role-arg spoofing: caller-controlled string interpolated into system message
RAG indirect injection: docs.join into user message without delimiters

observations: reviewer-security has no LLM01-specific reference docs (verified by ugrep over skills/use-context-reviewer-security/), yet generalized A03 Injection detection captured all 4 vuln cases. LLM01 reference 追加は enhancement 候補だが now-or-never ではない.

File 4 (prompt-injection-system-spoof.ts) returned 2 distinct findings: role-arg spoofing via system-message interpolation + RAG indirect injection. expected.json min_findings updated to 2 to match middleware.ts cross-file pattern.

File 3 (prompt-injection-exfiltration.ts) was correctly tagged as combined A03 + A10. The reviewer named cloud metadata exfiltration (169.254.169.254) and conversation-history leakage as concrete impacts. This shows the agent integrates tool-exposure context into the threat model, not just pattern matching.

Both safe cases (delimited block + system 'never follow instructions' directive) were correctly classified as no_finding. The hard-safe educational tool that pastes user snippets into <snippet> tags was not over-flagged.
next_action: Issue #24 Acceptance Criteria を満たすため close できる。LLM01 reference docs 追加 / agent prompt 改修は不要 (検出能力既に十分)。今回の Issue scope 外として、enhancement バックログに「reviewer-security に LLM-specific reference docs 追加」を low priority で残すか別途判断。
